assessments.reasoning: Question pers8 records relationships strictly relative to the main provider ('proveedora principal'), rather than using member-to-member grids or pointers; thus member_to_member_relationships is false. Question pers8 includes categories for relationships beyond spouse and parent-child (such as siblings, grandparents/grandchildren, and non-kin), so extended_ties is true. Questions hog2 and hog3 explicitly specify sharing food expenses as the criterion for identifying distinct households within a dwelling, so multiple_household_criteria is true. The questionnaire does not contain any questions or structural variables to identify sub-units or secondary family nuclei within a household, making sub-units false. Finally, while questions such as h16 and j7 mention care responsibilities as reasons for working fewer hours or not looking for work, the instrument does not identify caregiving relationships (who cares for whom), making caregiving_relationships false.
